items.definition: Percentile across explicitly eligible universe of N-native-candle return; average tie ranks. Ineligible/missing names stay blank.
100*Wilder ATR_N/close, seeded from first N true ranges after a prior close.
Consecutive strictly rising/falling closes; ties reset both, unavailable first change blank.
Sample standard deviation of N log returns, annualized by sqrt(252/k) or sqrt(12) for monthly, multiplied by 100.
Historical volatility(short)/historical volatility(long), same native timeframe; zero long volatility blank.
Full gap: open above previous high or below previous low, signed distance divided by previous ATR14. Separate signed close-to-open gap variant.
Gap at i assessed only at i+H, fill checked over i+1..i+H; fraction filled among gaps in last N mature cohorts. Both outcomes enter at maturity; no eligible gaps blank.
Unbiased sample skewness of N native-candle log returns.
Unbiased Fisher excess kurtosis of N native-candle log returns.
Pearson correlation between adjacent returns within N native-candle log returns (N-1 pairs); zero variance blank.

Single-window log(R/S)/log(N) on log returns; R is range of cumulative demeaned returns including zero and S sample standard deviation. Zero R/S blank. Explicit estimator, not an exact process parameter.
Squared Pearson correlation between close and bar index over N completed native candles; constant close blank.
Pearson correlation of N stock/benchmark simple native-candle returns on identical candle intervals.
Sample covariance(stock returns,benchmark returns)/sample variance(benchmark returns), matching N native intervals; zero benchmark variance blank.
100*(EMA_N(high-low)/EMA_N(high-low) shifted L native candles - 1), SMA-seeded EMA; zero prior EMA blank.
